notes.title: The Fabled Woods updates to Unreal Engine 5 with Version 1.1! 🌲
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37569367/1c96d673c2323d50d62d25de01468e217668f1ea.jpg

Greetings dear Explorers!

I know, I know ... It's been a while since my last update here on Steam. But I am back, and with nothing but good news! ːsteamhappyː I've tinkered for quite some time to update The Fabled Woods from Unreal Engine 4 - with which it was released with initially - to the current version of Unreal Engine 5!

And this brings a bunch of technical optimizations with it - DLSS3 for example, as well as a better ray tracing performance, new lighting, overall performance optimizations, etc.

Here is the complete list of additons, fixes, improvements, etc. version 1.1 adds to The Fabled Woods:

 Update to Unreal Engine 5
 New lighting
 Performance optimization
 Fixed several minor bugs
 Forest refinements added
 Wildlife added
 DLSS3/NIS added
 New Audio mixing added
 Loads of menu fixes
 No woods night time water fixed
 Weird reflections in water under bridges fixed
 Picture next to chemicals hard to pick up fixed
 Credits not playing fixed
 Spare room key hard to see fixed
 Support for ultrawide added
 DirectX 12 Crashing bugs fixed
 FOV slider added
These are 4 new shots out of the Fabled Woods in all its ray traced beatuy:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37569367/5948cc77878f6d6dbd35f380ed21c6c1aa602af5.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37569367/7760cb51be650ee1ae85f7d8d507fc68317e1ecf.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37569367/64cc051b0aaa515bc06624bf5563270b64be8806.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37569367/1578999503a39f1d6c5838f4045886ce3d73d886.jpg

All the best and stay healthy!
Joe - CyberPunch Studios

notes.title: Update 1.0.4 launched for The Fabled Woods!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37569367/e654d9be3faad25092865e36e09ffb4ada651b15.jpg

Greetings, explorer!

The new update 1.0.4 for The Fabled Woods is live! Here is the list of additions and issues that are now fixed:

 Added Invert Y option for controllers
 Added an option to turn off mouse smoothing
 Graphics now properly apply after making changes
 Ray Tracing performance has been stabilized
 General performance optimizations
 Launcher has been changed to allow launching the game in DX11 mode to avoid DX12 crashes
 Support has been added for Chinese (Simplified) and Spanish
 You should no longer encounter an invisible wall at the 3rd bridge on a new game
All feedback is of course welcome, be it positive or negative! Please share it with me on The Fabled Woods Discord or in the Steam Community. Thank you very much for your support! ❤️

Stay safe!
Joe

notes.title: The Fabled Woods is live & First update in the works!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37569367/af407ff3e2b271c558e4e4cd219e5cfe70ca5cdd.jpg

Greetings, explorer!

Finally, the big day is here: After more than two years, The Fabled Woods is finally out! ːsteamhappyː

And I really can't tell you how I feel right now. It's a mixture of excitement, fear and nervousness. A roller coaster of emotions. I can tell you that!

And you know, after the launch is before the launch. Taking a look at several streams and listening to you guys out there brought a bunch of issues to my list unfortunately. And I am really sorry about that! That was definitely not the plan, believe me that. ːsteamsadː

I am already working on fixing the issues. A new build is uploaded for QA already and is reviewed right now. And as soon as we checked it, I will get it out to all of you out there. Promise!

Here is a short list of the issues that I know and that I am working on:

 First purgatory world rock is not able to be picked up
 Localization is messed up with Russian, Japanese and French in the settings
 Black screen when going through close to the end of the game
 When reloading a game after starting there is an infinite loading screen
Once again - sorry for the problems you guys have out there. I hope you still have fun with my little game and I am doing everything to help you out!

All feedback is of course welcome, be it positive or negative! Please share it with me on The Fabled Woods Discord or in the Steam Community. Thank you very much for your support! ❤️

Stay safe!
Joe
